BEFORE YOU GET WRAPPING

A few good questions.

What makes this bubble wrap different?+

Our large-bubble wrap holds more air for better cushioning. Individual sheets tear off easily by hand, so you can pack without scissors or other tools.

How do I place an order?+

Text or call 825-925-1111 with your preferred length and quantity. Let us know whether you would like pickup or delivery. We will confirm availability and the order details with you.

Where can I buy bubble wrap in Calgary?+

You can order directly from BubbleWrapYYC and arrange pickup at D13, 6115 3 St SE, Calgary. Please contact us before visiting to confirm your pickup time.

Is delivery free?+

Calgary orders of $100 or more qualify for free delivery. For orders under $100, contact us with your address for a delivery quote.

What sizes do you offer?+

Choose 15 ft for $7, 100 ft for $25, or 200 ft for $50 CAD. Each roll is 12 inches wide, with individual sheets 10.2 inches long. Please confirm availability when you order.

Can I buy tape, stretch wrap, or boxes?+

We plan to expand our range of packing supplies. These items are not currently listed for sale on this website; text us to discuss your needs and availability.
